title: [main] Allocation Accounts with Invoice Discount produces wrong posted entries in Sales and Purchases documents in the Spanish version.
summary: Fixed incorrect posted entries when allocation accounts are used with invoice discounts in Spanish Sales and Purchase documents. The allocation logic now correctly uses the pre-discount line amount instead of the already-discounted amount.
key_points: Invoice discount was being applied twice to allocation accounts in Spanish documents
The root cause was using the already-discounted Amount field instead of the pre-discount Line Amount in allocation calculations
This fix ensures allocation accounts produce correct posted entries for both Sales and Purchase documents
Test cases were added to verify the fix
quote: Invoice discount was being applied twice, producing incorrect posted entries.
